checks.name: verified account sessions exist without principal, membership, entitlement or tenant grants; forged cookie and absent vault reference refuse
named invitation is idempotent, wrong identity and foreign work deny, acceptance binds one account and grants no access before consent
policy epoch changes deny both guest query and final document release; unsupported operator version is rejected by the database constraint
guest reads exact published views/collections with no forms or command metadata; query attribution is the actual account and member release rejects it; sibling work substitution refuses

add-to-canvas permission is independent, link is idempotent and account-private, old grant versions deny release, disabling placement hides links while preserving document view, no copied app or grants
real member command commit becomes visible through the linked original work without republishing or copying records
source deletion during query, configuration version change, and sponsor epoch change deny release; management reports paused rather than active
account epoch and session expiry deny cached access; account-only prelogin flow is single-use and bound to its server-side locator
revocation between query authorization and release blocks results and links; account actions append exactly-once transactional audit and every tenant grant/member/app footprint stays unchanged
verified mailbox change keeps immutable account identity, advances account epoch, and invalidates both old cookie and cached account authority

same-org verified account follows identical consent, concurrent acceptance is idempotent, placement revoke cleans once, reenable requires new Add, 100 expired links cannot strand quota, and session revocation never deletes references

account FORCE RLS refuses blank/foreign account reads and data-role writes; bounded cross-account sweeper deletes at most100 expired sessions per call and preserves accounts, grants and linked references

APP-178: organization shutdown (status suspended) denies the guest's final release, a result computed before it, work reads, a new query, access resolution and connected links; restoring the organization restores access; the shutdown removed the connected link (audited), and an explicit Add links it again
APP-178: two independent grants of one work to one account: revoking the first denies it and removes its link, while the second still resolves to the same access, reads and releases
APP-178: an invitation past its expiry cannot be accepted or resolved, and the refusal equals the one for a key that never existed
APP-144 shared JSON retains every admitted part in default_layout order and literal note text; form parts are view-only labels without command identity, selectors or member routes

real HTTP owner defaults/list/version conflict, verified named consent, cross-site/closed-body/oversize denials, confined engine numeric shared receipts, guest-only member API denials, zero-query authority polling, and revocation after engine computation prevent stale JSON release
